description: This PHP source file defines a migration class 'GoteoSdg' responsible for setting up and tearing down database tables and seed data related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), footprints, categories, social commitments, and spheres within the Goteo project. It includes methods for pre- and post-migration logic, SQL for schema changes, and seed data insertion.

classes.name: GoteoSdg
classes.description: Migration class for setting up SDG-related database schema and seed data, including methods for migration steps and SQL statements.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Placeholder for pre-migration logic before applying schema changes.

methods.name: postUp
methods.description: Performs seed data insertion and relationship setup for SDGs, footprints, social commitments, and spheres after schema creation.

methods.name: preDown
methods.description: Placeholder for pre-migration logic before rollback.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to create tables, constraints, and seed initial data for SDGs and related entities.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to drop tables and revert schema changes made in getUpSQL.
